answer: The protocol validates 1,000 distinct service slots via capacity-reservations, where each agent secures a dedicated temporal ledge for data bursts. A verifier probes these reserved sectors to ensure no relay signal interference, confirming each link maintains an opal clarity in round-trip timings. This mechanism creates a secure haven against pooled hardware, as shared infrastructure induces measurable latency jitter. Honest participants pay 1x cost per slot, while attackers incur 1,000x for isolated, non-pooled capacity. Fees remain locked for 90 days to deter churn.
